nodes.label: Skellam Distribution Formulation
nodes.rationale: Under Poisson conditional independence of match scores, goal difference follows a Skellam (Poisson-Difference) distribution, enabling extraction of implicit scoring intensities from odds.

nodes.label: Dynamic Seasonal Team Effects
nodes.rationale: Attack and defence strengths are assumed dynamic across seasons following a Normal distribution centred at previous season effects plus fixed drift, avoiding static limitations.

nodes.label: Betting Efficiency & Decision Threshold Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Examines discrepancies theta across average and maximum market odds, demonstrating that seasonal ROI maximisation does not guarantee overall long-term profitability.

nodes.label: Bookmaker Implied Probability Regression Model
nodes.rationale: Evaluates whether bookmakers adjust odds before a goal via 1/mintogoal alongside pre-match probabilities, time elapsed, red cards, and xG difference.

nodes.label: Continuous-Valued State-Space Model for Bettors
nodes.rationale: Employs an AR(1) latent state process with zero-one-inflated beta observation distribution to capture unobserved market activity and serial correlation in relative stakes.

nodes.label: Efficient Market Hypothesis in Sports Betting (EMH)
nodes.norm_label: efficient market hypothesis in sports betting (emh)

nodes.label: Odds-Only-Equal-Profitability-Confidence (OO-EPC) Method
nodes.rationale: Reduces inverse odds by a constant multiple of standard errors (z*sigma) to reflect the bookmaker objective of having equal confidence in profitability without needing historical data.

nodes.label: Draw Bias Phenomenon
nodes.rationale: Draw outcomes have a weaker favourite-longshot bias than decisive outcomes, causing uniform bias-adjustment methods to underestimate draw probabilities.

nodes.label: FL-GLM (Favourite-Longshot Bias Adjusted GLM)
nodes.rationale: Data-driven model to adjust for the favourite-longshot bias measured from historical betting odds.

nodes.label: Two Power Constants FL-GLM Extension
nodes.rationale: Introduces separate beta_decisive and beta_draw parameters fitted via maximum likelihood to alleviate draw bias under weaker favourite-longshot bias in draws.

nodes.label: Property 5
nodes.rationale: Proves multiplicative conversion is equivalent to FL-GLM when power constant beta is assumed to be 1.

nodes.label: Property 6
nodes.rationale: Proves power conversion is equivalent to FL-GLM when the normalisation term is assumed to be 1.

nodes.label: Proposition 7 (Log-Loss and Profitability)
nodes.rationale: Proves log-loss captures bookmakers' profitability because difference in log-loss directly derives the payout ratio u = exp(-v).

nodes.label: Multinomial Logit Regression (MLR)
nodes.rationale: Evaluated as an alternative to OLR to relax proportional odds and allow independent variables to influence draw probabilities without altering win/loss ratios.

nodes.label: Ordered Logit Regression (OLR)
nodes.rationale: Commonly used due to natural hierarchy of match outcomes (win > draw > loss), but restricted by proportional odds assumption.

nodes.label: Success Score DNN Predictor
nodes.rationale: 68-dimensional input architecture with 4 hidden layers (256, 128, 64, 1) and Tanh activations to predict home team Success Score.

nodes.label: Success Score Metric
nodes.rationale: Combines Expected Goals (xG) and actual goals scored via sigmoid scaling to balance chance quality and conversion efficiency while ensuring team interdependence.

nodes.label: Tactical Play Styles Framework
nodes.rationale: Categorizes 10 playing styles using FBref match metrics to inject tactical dimensions into predictive modeling.
